messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alerting provider reports delivery delays for critical routing pool. Multiple alerts not delivered/acked in the last 7m. Auto-created thread. Notifying #incidents.

alex: seeing spikes in alert queue, a bunch of duplicate notifications stuck with status=queued on our webhook bridge.

maria: i'm oncall, confirming — i didn't get the pages for the last deploy-failure alerts.

pagerbridge-bot: [log] 2026-05-02T18:02:15Z WARN notify.delivery.delay id=abc123 status=queued retry_count=3 route=eu-prod

alex: looks like the third‑party (PagerBridge) is returning 504s on their notify endpoint and our adapter is buffering.

samir: are we missing customer-impacting events? which teams/customers were supposed to be paged?

alex: the deploy pipeline and the L7 api SLO alerts were routed to the eu-prod pool — that's our enterprise EU tenant list. If unacked for >10m they escalate to phone which didn't happen.

julia: @cs-lead heads-up: enterprise customers might have missed outage pages in EU, recommend proactive reach.

maria: mitigation plan — 1) failover alert routing to our backup webhook (direct to slack + email) 2) enable phone-calls via Twilio fallback for critical oncall 3) open PD incident with PagerBridge support 4) notify customer success to contact affected accounts.

alex: doing 1) now. updating routing rules:
```
# quick curl to update route to backup
curl -X PATCH -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \"https://api.redwood-inference.internal/alert-routing/pools/eu-prod\" -d '{"fallback": "backup-webhook"}'
```

incident-bot: Execute runbook step: enable-backup-routing succeeded (runbook step 3).

alex: backup routing live. new alerts should go into #incidents-direct and email. sending synthetic test alert.

maria: received test via slack and email. phone still not triggered for earlier events.

pagerbridge-bot: [log] 2026-05-02T18:07:54Z ERROR ack.timeout id=abc123 reason=upstream-timeout

alex: confirms ack failures — not client side. We're getting ack.timeout from PB.

samir: contacting PagerBridge support and including logs (chunks attached). @eng-lead are we ok to escalate to phone tree for all critical alerts until PB resolves?

eng-lead: yes, approve. prefer temporary override vs messing with policy config too long. Document expiry time.

maria: i set override: phone_calls_enabled=true for 2 hours; will revoke earlier if PB fixed.

cs-lead: i'll draft a short proactive message to affected customers — mention potential delayed pages and that we're actively routing to backup and phone fallback.

alex: also adding a metric dashboard card for undelivered_alert_count and routing latency so ops can watch.

oncall-sre: handoff note for night: current state — backup routing active, phone fallback enabled until 20:15 UTC, PagerBridge support case #PB-6789 opened. Impact: possible delayed/non-acked pages 17:55-18:05 UTC for EU pool. Actions: monitor alerts, if new undelivered >5 escalate to exec.

samir: PagerBridge support replied — their engineering is seeing routing congestion in the EU edge and a partial suppression of webhook delivery. They recommend pausing retries to avoid queue blowup.

alex: pausing retries now (adapter flag retry.enabled=false) — running for 5m then reassess.

maria: note: pausing retries causes some alerts to drop unless backup routing is active; that's why backup routing is critical.

pagerbridge-bot: [status] 2026-05-02T18:18:12Z PagerBridge acknowledged support case PB-6789. Root cause under investigation.

cs-lead: shared customer note sent to 4 affected accounts (email + in-app). will update if we learn more.

eng-lead: create postmortem ticket and assign to alex to own write-up. include timeline, impact, and decision to enable fallback + pause retries.

alex: created MR: infra/incident-pm-1791234567 and postmortem ticket INF-3421. Initial triage complete. Leaving handoff to samir for watch.

samir: taking watch. will ping at next 30m check or sooner if pagerbridge clears.

maria: thanks team — closing active notification escalations, keep thread for updates. :white_check_mark:
